why: The session never reads the flag, so `?dev=1&ownerPalette=high-contrast` parses, reports as accepted in the developer pane and changes nothing (issue #1057). Since issue #1058 this is also the 'flag no longer overrides the setting' control, modelled on loop-quality-flag-stops-overriding-the-setting: it is the natural edit once a setting exists, and wrong, because a flag that must not write the player's save has no other way to be honoured. Every reader still agrees with every other, which is why only a test that sets the flag and reads what a reader was handed can see it.
killedBy: startGameWith: a real player death reaches the HUD flashes a two-player FFA death in the session's owner palette (issue #1057)

startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default threads the ownerPalette dev flag to every reader, once per session (issue #1057) hands the renderer and the stock HUD the SAME palette the flag names, before any status
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default lets ?dev=1&ownerPalette= OVERRIDE the stored palette, without writing it
